about.what: Tables of the D3x wrong-layout operator (src/utils/layout_keys.py) for the browser converter site/assets/js/keyconv.js; every table is materialised from the Python operator, so the browser reproduces it without Unicode normalisation or an RNG.

korean2set.source: keyboard_ops._KO_KEY (KS X 5002), verified key by key against libhangul by the repository generator

about.levels: shift levels 1-2 only; AltGr (levels 3-4) is not modelled; ISO key LSGT excluded
about.cellFormat: cells[i] = [level1, level2] of key keys[i]; a string, null (no character) or {dead: <hex combining mark>}
